[[File:Abafar_menu_1.png|thumb|left|Ewok Jerky on Power Sliders' menu.]]
'''Ewok Jerky''' was a type of [[Jerky/Legends|jerky]] dish made with [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] meat. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Ewok Jerky was served in [[Pons Ora/Legends|Pons Ora's]] [[Power Sliders/Legends|Power Sliders]], located on the remote [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Abafar/Legends|Abafar]].
